# opnsense_caddy_access_list (Resource)

Manages a Caddy access list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_caddy_access_list" "management" {
  name       = "management"
  client_ips = ["10.0.0.0/24", "10.10.0.0/24"]

  request_matcher = "client_ip"
  description     = "Management and VPN networks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_ips` (Set of String) Client IP addresses or networks allowed or denied by this access list.
- `name` (String) Name of the access list.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description. Defaults to `""`.
- `http_response_code` (Number) Optional HTTP response status returned for denied requests. `-1` uses the Caddy default.
- `http_response_message` (String) Optional response message returned for denied requests. Defaults to `""`.
- `invert` (Boolean) When enabled, invert the client IP match. Defaults to `false`.
- `request_matcher` (String) Address matcher used by Caddy: `client_ip` or `remote_ip`. Defaults to `client_ip`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the access list.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_caddy_access_list using its ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_caddy_access_list.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```
